skill.name: Pretty Attack
skill.description: Fires pink hearts which emanates from its adorable body at the enemy.

skill.name: Black Matter
skill.description: Unleashes an evil orb from the Digimon hiding within it.

skill.name: Tear Shoot
skill.description: Concentrates power in its forehead antenna, then fires a beautiful water orb at the opponent.

skill.name: Luna Claw
skill.description: Scratches with claws that are lovely at first glance, but are filled with the power of darkness.

skill.name: Lop-ear Ripple
skill.description: Twirls its ears, swallowing up the opponent in the vortex of bubbles generated.

skill.name: Pico Darts
skill.description: Attacks with syringes of darkness.

skill.name: Moon Night Kick
skill.description: Leaps high into the air and performs a diving kick.

skill.name: Tear Arrow
skill.description: Pulls beautiful arrows of ice from the protrusions on its back and fires them.

skill.name: Moon Night Bomb
skill.description: Creates hypnotic water bubbles from the Moon Glove and throws them to lull the enemy to sleep.

skill.name: Lunatic Dance
skill.description: Entrances the enemy with its dance-like steps, after which it closes the distance and slashes with the Nova Luna , that it wields in both hands.

skill.name: Ice Archery
skill.description: Combines its two Nova Luna into a bowgun and fires an arrow of ice.

skill.name: Dark Archery
skill.description: Combines its two Nova Luna into a bowgun and fires an arrow made from dark energy.

skill.name: Strike Roll
skill.description: A forward rolling slash with Olympia that splits the ground.

skill.name: Madness Merry-go-round
skill.description: A spinning horizontal slash with Olympia . Can be used to create a whirlwind.

skill.name: Dominion Blade
skill.description: A vertical slash with Olympia that sends a blade of air at the enemy.

skill.name: Olympia Slash
skill.description: Slashes a foe with Olympia .

skill.name: Baby Flame
skill.description: Spits a fiery breath from its mouth.

skill.name: Spitfire
skill.description: Spits out fireballs.

skill.name: Cross Fight
skill.description: Viciously bites the enemy.

skill.name: Surudoi Tsume
skill.description: Attacks with its claws.

skill.name: Toy Flame
skill.description: Fires a flame-shaped toy missile.

skill.name: Block Punch
skill.description: Punches the enemy, sometimes causing a pillar of fire.

skill.name: Fancy Star
skill.description: Surrounds its self with miniature stars before throwing a large star.

skill.name: Baby Flame
skill.description: Spits a fiery breath from its mouth to attack the opponent.

skill.name: Burning Fist
skill.description: 1 2 3 Flares up its arms and knocks away the opponent. Throws fireballs from its fists. Flares up its entire body to burn the opponent.

skill.name: Guren no Honō
skill.description: Shoots fireballs at the opponent.

skill.name: Magma Bomb
skill.description: 1 2 Emits magma rocks that rain upon its opponents. Throws one large, explosive magma rock.

skill.name: Heat Wave
skill.description: Unleashes a wave of flames.
